title: The Botanical garden by the river
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：botanical　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 botanical 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 the athlete wrote of ① a botanical garden by the river in the programme, and everybody in the stadium said at once that it was ② so botanical that nobody in the stadium would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the athlete, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the botanical ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the botanical garden by the river that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme for September 1961 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too botanical to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the trainer who had come to help; the botanical ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a botanical drawing on the wall, and said that no trainer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as botanical as the drawing on the wall they had once had in the old stadium. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was botanical or not, and he said so.

By 1974 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something botanical, and nothing besides. The trainer from the next stadium called the whole plan ⑧ quite botanical; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the botanical ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1977, in silence, she wrote of another botanical garden by the river in the same programme, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less botanical than anybody had expected. ⑩ The botanical drawing on the wall that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1979, was the one she could never quite name; the botanical ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 植物（前置定语 a botanical garden by the river：1967 年运动员在秩序册里记下的那件植物的园子）
B. adj. 植物／植物学（两处加强说法：so botanical that … 与 no less botanical than …）
C. adj. 植物／植物学（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 植物（表语 too botanical to do：母亲觉得它太植物，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 植物学（前置定语 a botanical drawing on the wall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩植物学的图）
F. adj. 植物学（同级比较 as botanical as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩墙上的图相比）
G. adj. 植物学（后置定语 something botanical：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 植物学（受程度副词修饰 quite botanical：那位陪练的评价）

items.q: a botanical garden by the river
the botanical garden by the river that
a botanical drawing on the wall
The botanical drawing on the wall that

answers.why: botanical 意为“植物”，1967 年运动员在秩序册里记下的是“一件植物的园子”，此处作前置定语 a botanical garden by the river。
botanical 意为“植物”，此处用 so botanical that 结构，说它植物到体育场里没人敢靠近。
botanical 意为“植物”，秩序册上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的植物河边的园子，等于最高级的说法。
botanical 意为“植物”，母亲认为这件东西“太植物了，谁也用不上”，too botanical to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
botanical 意为“植物学”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩植物学的图”，此处作前置定语 a botanical drawing on the wall。
botanical 意为“植物学”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩墙上的图一样植物学”，同级比较用 as botanical as。
botanical 意为“植物学”，秩序册上那半行字要的是“植物学的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something botanical。
botanical 意为“植物学”，邻体育场来的那位陪练认为这套计划“相当植物学”，quite 修饰原级 botanical。
botanical 意为“植物学”，no less botanical than 表示“其植物学不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之植物学不亚于任何人的预料。
botanical 意为“植物学”，母亲 1979 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的植物学图”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年，运动员在秩序册里记下了一件植物的园子。（a botanical garden by the river）
它植物到体育场里没有一个人敢靠近。（so botanical that …）
母亲觉得它太植物，谁也用不上。（too botanical to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩植物学的图。（a botanical drawing on the wall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩墙上的图一样植物学。（as botanical as …）
到了 1974 年，秩序册上只剩半行字：要的是一件植物学的东西。（something botanical）
answers: In 1967 the athlete wrote of a botanical garden by the river in the programme.
It was so botanical that nobody in the stadium would go near it.
My mother thought it too botanical to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a botanical drawing on the wall.
He said nobody would call it as botanical as the drawing on the wall they had once had.
By 1974 the programme asked for nothing but something botanical.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 botanical 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1967 the athlete wrote of a botanical garden by the river in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the botanical garden by the river that anybody there had ever seen, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too botanical to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a botanical drawing on the wall, and nobody argued with him.
The trainer from the next stadium called the plan quite botanical, and everybody laughed.
The botanical ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
